card.name: Inside all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: Words and word parts inside ALL-CAPS text, mostly boxed-warning headlines, often partway through a term or at a linking word. It also appears in a few all-caps non-drug headings.

modes.label: Boxed warning titles
modes.description: Marks the end of or a spot within a capitalized warning heading, such as an abbreviation or hyphenated term.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS PULMONARY OIL MICROEMBOLISM (POME<<)>> REACTIONS AND ANAPHYLAX

modes.label: Capitalized running text
modes.description: Marks a part of a word or a linking word within capitalized sentences in warning paragraphs.
modes.example: ITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH DEMENTIA-<<RELATED>> PSYCHOSIS and SUIC

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward word endings that continue a capitalized term, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up inside capitalized warning headlines, particularly partway through a term.
